Jackson-Bibby Awareness Group, Inc. is a State of California Licensed Driving-Under-the-Influence (DUI) Education Program that offers classes, counseling, and mentoring tailored for both first-time and repeat DUI offenders. Operating throughout California, our programs are designed to meet both individual and community needs since 1981. We emphasize the severe consequences of drinking and driving on personal, family, and community levels. Working closely with the Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) and the Courts, we aim to facilitate compliance and aid in the reinstatement of driving privileges. Our team, comprised of CATC and/or ACCBC Certified Addictions Treatment Counselors, along with other licensed professionals, is dedicated to guiding you through the program towards personal growth and lasting lifestyle improvements. Program Offerings 3 or 4 Month First Offender Program For California residents facing their first DUI offense with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) under 0.15%. Spanning 3 or 4 months based on individual requirements, it includes a 30-hour AB 541 alcohol education class aimed at highlighting the dangers of DUI, impacting not only the individual but also broader community ties. Courses are available in both English and Spanish. Learn More 12-Hour Wet Reckless Program Designed for those convicted of alcohol-related reckless driving with a BAC under 0.08%, this course underscores the risks associated with impaired driving and its broader implications. Courses are available in both English and Spanish. 6-Month First Offender Program For individuals facing their first DUI with a BAC between 0.15% and 0.19%, this program engages participants in extensive group counseling and educational sessions to discuss the dangers of impaired driving and strategies for safer decision-making. Courses are available in both English and Spanish. 9-Month First Offender Program For those with a BAC above 0.20% facing their first DUI charge, this program involves comprehensive counseling and educational sessions focused on alcohol and drug awareness, responsibility, and the risks of drunk driving. Courses are available in both English and Spanish. 18-Month Multiple Offender Program This program is specifically for individuals with multiple DUI offenses, focusing on prevention and community reintegration. It includes group counseling, educational talks on substance abuse, and activities aimed at community reintegration. Courses are available in both English and Spanish. Learn More In-person and Virtual Group Options Our DUI education programs are accessible both in-person and online to accommodate different learning preferences. In-person sessions provide direct engagement, while virtual classes offer convenience and accessibility from anywhere in California. Thank you, Katherine for supporting me and helping me get through this dark time in my life.” (First-Time Offender, Redlands) “I’ve learned a lot due to these classes. Lionel made our class interesting, fun and very informative. This has been a very humiliating experience that has taught me a very valuable lesson.” (First-Time Offender, Redlands) “My first 52 weeks, Gary was an absolute pleasure to spend one night a week with.
